name: 🩸 Hidden Within
desc:
WWII Update (September 1st): Survive in the new REQUISITION MAP for 3-minutes, new THOMPSON machine gun is now collectible in the lobby. Ascend to equip TWO CLASSES.

Roles:
 Survivors (Survive 3 minutes to receive a knife to eliminate the killer) , 
 Vigilante (Gets a knife at the start of the round. 1 Vigilante Per round), 
 Killer (Eliminate everyone. spare nobody. 1-2 Killers per round)

Controls : (Controller / Keyboard + Mouse)
 Movement; 
  DPadDown / C - Crouch/Prone | 
  DPadUp / X - Stand | 
  ButtonL3 / LeftShift - Sprint |
  ButtonA / Q - Ragdoll/UnRagdoll |

 Gun;
  ButtonL2 / Right Click - Shoot | 
  ButtonR2 / Left Click - Aim | 
  ButtonX / R - Reload |
  ButtonB / T - Reroll Gun |
